'''Josep Antoni Gómes Moreira'''<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.faf.ad/pnfg/NNws_ShwNewDup?codigo=1005414&cod_primaria=3000301&cod_secundaria=3000301|publisher=[[Andorran Football Federation]]|date=9 September 2013|accessdate=3 February 2018|language=Catalan|title=Convocatòria de l'absoluta davant la subcampiona del món}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.faf.ad/pnfg/NNws_ShwNewDup?codigo=1005809&cod_primaria=3000302&cod_secundaria=3000302|publisher=[[Andorran Football Federation]]|date=13 November 2014|accessdate=3 February 2018|language=Catalan|title=Convocatòria de la selecció absoluta pel partit a domicili contra Xipre}}</ref> (born 3 December 1985) is an [[Andorra]]n international [[association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[Goalkeeper (association football)|goalkeeper]] for [[CE Casa de Portugal|Casa de Portugal]].

==Career==
Born in [[La Massana]], Gómes spent most of his club career playing in the Spanish league system, representing [[FC Andorra]], [[UD Ibiza-Eivissa]], [[CD Ciudad de Vícar]] and [[CF San Rafael]].<ref name = "NFT">{{NFT player|id=11181}}</ref>

He made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] in 2006,<ref name = "NFT"/> and has represented them in FIFA World Cup qualifying matches.<ref>{{FIFA player|217271}}</ref><ref>[https://peru.com/futbol/eliminatorias-rusia-2018/portugal-vs-andorra-vivo-online-y-directo-eliminatorias-rusia-2018-noticia-477620 Portugal aplastó a Andorra por las Eliminatorias Rusia 2018] Andorra: Josep Gómes</ref>

On 25 March 2019, during a UEFA Euro qualifying match against Albania, Gómes made what one sports website described as a "howler"<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.espnfc.com/video/latest-videos/600/video/3808672|title=Berisha howler gifts Albania victory - ESPN Video|date=2019-03-25|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2019-03-25}}</ref> that gifted Albania the opening goal when he tried an acrobatic flying kick to clear the ball but failed to do so. His team went on to lose 3–0.
